Template Help
fields.options:
How a template works

Design the file in Excel or LibreOffice, type placeholders into the cells, then upload it here. Column fieldnames are shown in the report's Pick Columns menu, or in the script report's code.

{{ data.amount }}A report column, by its fieldname. The row repeats once per report row.
{{ filters.company }}A filter value applied on the report.
{{ total_row.amount }}The report's total row (when the report has one).
{{ report_name }}The report's name.
{{ data|length }}Number of report rows (in a normal cell).

Everything else in the file is kept: styles, merged cells, column widths, number formats, formulas, conditional formatting, dropdowns, images and print settings. When rows repeat, everything below moves down and formulas follow, so =SUM(D5:D5) under a repeating row 5 becomes =SUM(D5:D7) for three rows.

Shapes, text boxes, SmartArt, pivot tables and macros are not kept. You'll see a warning when you save if the file has them.

fields.default:
# Available: report_name, filters, columns, data, total_row, wb, ws, xf, frappe
ws.title = "Report"
ws["A1"] = report_name
ws["A1"].font = Font(bold=True, size=14)

applied = [str(key) + ": " + str(value) for key, value in filters.items() if value]
ws["A2"] = ", ".join(applied)

xf.write_table(ws, columns, data, start_row=4, total_row=total_row)
xf.autofit_columns(ws)
fields.label: Python Script
Script Help
fields.options:
Report Excel Format help

The script runs in Frappe's server-script sandbox each time someone exports the report. It must build the workbook in wb.

report_nameName of the report being exported
filtersFilter values the user applied, as a dict
columnsList of dicts with fieldname, label, fieldtype, options, width
dataReport rows, as a list of dicts keyed by fieldname (total row removed)
total_rowThe report's total row as a dict, or None
wb, wsThe openpyxl workbook and its active sheet
Font, Alignment, Border, Side, PatternFill, Image, get_column_letteropenpyxl helpers. Other openpyxl names can be imported with from openpyxl... import Name
xf.write_table(ws, columns, data, start_row=1, start_col=1, total_row=None, header=True)Writes a styled table with number and date formats. Returns the first empty row after it
xf.autofit_columns(ws)Sets column widths from their content
xf.number_format(fieldtype)Excel number format for a Frappe fieldtype
frappeThe same safe frappe object Server Scripts use

Supported report types: Script Report, Query Report and Custom Report.
